import subprocess,re,json,os
paths=set(filter(None,subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard','-z']).decode().split('\0')))|set(filter(None,subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','-z']).decode().split('\0')))
patterns=[('provider-key',re.compile(rb'\bsk-(?:proj-|or-v1-)?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32,}')),('github-key',re.compile(rb'\b(?:ghp_|github_pat_)[A-Za-z0-9_]{35,}')),('private-key',re.compile(rb'-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----')),('bearer-token',re.compile(rb'(?i)Bearer\s+eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}'))]
findings=[]
for p in paths:
 if not os.path.isfile(p):continue
 b=open(p,'rb').read()
 for name,rx in patterns:
  if rx.search(b):findings.append({'path':p,'type':name,'matches':len(rx.findall(b))})
json.dump({'files':len(paths),'findings':findings},open('.local/seven-smart-2026-10-20/credential-scan.json','w'),indent=2)
print('scanned',len(paths),'files; findings',len(findings));print(json.dumps(findings[:12]))
